body: After /clear the channel MCP server is NOT restarted (observed: one probe process, stale env session id, inbound and permission relay reach the post-clear session). Chosen: agent reports its own claude pid in Register (optional field, VERSION stays 1) and the hub (re)binds agent conns by host+claude_pid on SessionStart and on registration. Rejected alternative: new HubMsg::Rebind telling the agent to re-register (needs a VERSION bump and still needs the pid on the hub).

Headless agents (CLAUDE_CODE_ENTRYPOINT=sdk-cli) serve MCP but never connect to the hub: -p never initializes channels (TASK-004), and this also covers nested runs whose process chain is broken by exec wrappers. Rejected: register and let the hub drop them (hub nesting detection has known holes).
Dev channels accept a server defined via --mcp-config (debug: probe13 Channel notifications registered), so live checks use a temp --mcp-config instead of writing ~/.claude.json.

Install command: new subcommand `cctg agent-install` prints `claude mcp add --scope user cctg -- "<abs exe>" agent` (does not run it: writing ~/.claude.json stays a user step). Rejected: a docs file with a placeholder path (not guaranteed absolute) and running `claude mcp add` from cctg.

Reply tool input problems are isError tool results, unknown tool/missing name are -32602, other methods -32601 (MCP 2025-11-25 tools error handling). Rejected: -32602 for bad reply arguments (model cannot self-correct).

git archive under core.autocrlf=true produced CRLF files in the reference workspace; python text-mode edits turned edited files into LF, so the first patch touched every file. Fixed by normalizing ws/ to LF before build_patch.py.

initialize echoes any of 2025-11-25/2025-06-18/2025-03-26/2024-11-05 and answers 2025-11-25 otherwise; missing/empty/non-string version is -32602. Rejected alternative: always answer 2025-11-25 (PLAN_V2), because the MCP TypeScript client throws "Server's protocol version is not supported" when the server answers a revision the client does not know, so an older client asking 2025-06-18 would fail.

Invalid Request id policy: id null when jsonrpc is not exactly "2.0" (not a JSON-RPC 2.0 message, id untrusted); a 2.0 request with a string/number id but scalar/null params gets -32600 with its id echoed so the client does not wait for a timeout. Rejected alternative: id null for every envelope error.

First Start-before-End /clear slots test assumed the new session gets a second topic (#2) and waited for ALIVE on thread 101; it timed out: with the same claude pid the new session takes slot 100 (separator + rename, no new topic). Test rewritten to assert on thread 100 and on the reconnect with the stale env id.

Live E2E registered the freshly built agent under the MCP name cctgqa (server:cctgqa) in a temp --mcp-config instead of cctg, so it cannot collide with a user-scope cctg entry. Rejected: reusing the name cctg as the planner did.

Permission ids: forward every well-formed hub verdict and drop the id from the 256-entry recently-relayed FIFO on verdict, so a re-issued id after a verdict is relayed again. Alternative rejected: keep verdicted ids in the FIFO until evicted (would silently swallow a legitimately repeated id).
